d:
Security forces have killed Lashkar-e-Taiba commander Latif Bhat and another terrorist in an encounter in Laroo, Kulgam, on November 16. Latif was allegedly involved in the November 11 attack on a CRPF convoy that left three personnel injured. A search operation is still underway.
Production: Neha Dhiman
Video Editor: Ravi Gangwar
